notes: porter declared unbuildable after 1 attempt(s): The code under test is the Jolt verifier itself and has no no_std path. The lifted body would be `JoltVerifierPreprocessing::<F,Curve,PCS>::deserialize_with_mode(..)` + `RV64IMACVerifier::new(..).verify()`, both of which live entirely in jolt-core. jolt-core is not a no_std crate (jolt-core/src/lib.rs has no `#![no_std]`; 157 `use std::` sites across 80 files, 159 rayon/`par_iter` sites across 26 files in zkvm alone) and its own manifest documents this at jolt-core/Cargo.toml:38-40: `# jolt-core needs std and rayon to compile, so these are the minimal set of features.` / `minimal = ["ark-ec/std", "ark-ff/std", "ark-std/std", "ark-ff/asm", "rayon"]`. rayon means OS threads, which a Jolt guest does not have. This is not a std->core/alloc repoint; it is a port of the whole proving library, i.e. an algorithm-level rewrite, which the invariant forbids. Compounding this, jolt-sdk exposes the verifier ONLY through `guest-verifier = ["guest-std", "dep:common", "jolt-core/minimal"]` (jolt-sdk/Cargo.toml:41) — the feature is definitionally the musl/std guest runtime (`zeroos-runtime-musl`, `postcard/use-std`, `serde/std`, `jolt-platform/std`), so enabling it would switch the template out of no_std into std/musl mode, which is explicitly not allowed (it changes the study target). Corroborating evidence that this program is std-only by construction: the corpus host builds this one guest with `program.set_std(true)` (corpus/src/recursion/src/main.rs:477), and the guest's `#![cfg_attr(feature = "guest", no_std)]` line is commented out (corpus/src/recursion/guest/src/lib.rs:1). Two further independent blockers: (a) the program source is incomplete — it does `include!("./embedded_bytes.rs")` and `include!("./provable_macro.rs")`, both host-generated at runtime by `generate_embedded_bytes`/`generate_provable_macro` and gitignored (corpus/src/recursion/guest/.gitignore), so they are absent from the read-only corpus and there is nothing to lift verbatim; (b) sizing — the frozen template attribute in this tree is `#[jolt::provable(heap_size = 32768, max_trace_length = 65536)]` (32 KiB heap), while the program's own host config requires heap_size 33554432-134217728 and max_input_size up to 2000000 for the serialized preprocessing+proof blob; per the hard rule I did not alter the attribute line, but even with the other blockers resolved the verifier preprocessing could not be deserialized into a 32 KiB heap. No files were modified; the tree is left at the null-control placeholder.
